# gzhflow — DeepSeek Harness bundle patch.
# Installed via `dsh plugin add https://github.com/Andiii208/gzhflow`.
# Registers the six-stage workflow's quality-gate tools and ships the gzhflow

- insert:
    - id: gzhflow-tools

    - id: gzhflow-skill

readme.section: gzhflow · 跨 Agent 公众号内容发布工作流
readme.text:
[](LICENSE)

一套**可复用、跨主流 AI Agent** 的微信公众号内容发布工作流框架：从「一个主题」到「草稿箱里一篇排好版、配好图、去过 AI 味的文章」，六阶段流水线 + 每步质量门。

> 适配 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex CLI / Gemini CLI / Qwen Code / DeepSeek 等主流 Agent，也兼容 Hermes 的 SKILL.md 格式（同源标准）。

- **跨 Agent 开箱即用**：`AGENTS.md` 单一真源 + `CLAUDE.md` 一行桥接，任何 Agent 打开即懂
- **七阶段流水线**：素材先行 → 写作 → 去AI味 → 配图 → 排版 → 推草稿箱 → 复盘回写
- **四库 + 状态机**：收件箱 / 范文锚 / 风格档案 / 教训库在下沉淀，`state.md` 跨会话接续
- **质检门有实测依据**：规则来自 629 篇 283 万字的对照语料研究（`lieflat-less-ai-tone`，MIT），不是拍脑袋
- **个人化可替换**：文风/配图风格/排版主题全部走 `config/` 配置 + `examples/` 模板，流程不绑定个人
- **质量门三件套**：脚本门（确定性）+ 清单门（LLM 自检）+ 人工门（审阅/dry-run）
- **发布层个人号可用**：官方 API `draft/add` 推草稿箱（个人订阅号可用），手动粘贴兜底
- **纯 CLI 工具**：stdlib 优先，无外部依赖，跨平台
```bash

cp config/workflow.example.yaml config/workflow.yaml
cp config/styles.example.yaml config/styles.yaml
cp config/themes.example.yaml config/themes.yaml
cp config/publish.example.yaml config/publish.yaml
python scripts/validate_repo.py

```

完整步骤见 [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md)。

readme.section: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用（DSH 插件）
readme.text:
gzhflow 同时打包为 DSH 插件（`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`），可一键安装：

```bash

readme.section: 全局注册 7 个 gzhflow_* 工具（6 个质检门 + 环境自检）并随包携带 gzhflow skill
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Andiii208/gzhflow
```

装完在任意会话说「用 gzhflow 写一篇关于 XX 的公众号文章」，或用 skill 工具加载 `gzhflow`。

想要「公众号主编」人设（会话级 persona + 环境自检引导）可另装 Agent 预设（opt-in）：bash
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File dsh-preset/install.ps1   # Windows
bash dsh-preset/install.sh                                       # macOS / Linux
```

详见 [`dsh-preset/README.md`](dsh-preset/README.md)。

| 阶段 | 作用 | 质量门 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 素材先行 | **先翻收件箱和对话存量**，缺什么才问，只问一轮 | 意图三问 |
| ② 写作 | 读风格档案 + 范文锚，按文风路由写作 | `ai_flavor_score.py` + 自检四问 |
| ③ 去AI味 | 三环：结构手术 → 冷读重写 → 分视角评审 | `ai_flavor_score.py` 复检 |
| ④ 配图（可选） | 图源三问 → 风格路由 → 四段式编译 | `check_image_prompt.py` |
| ⑤ 排版 | 主题路由 → Markdown 转公众号 HTML | `validate_gzh_html.py` |
| ⑥ 发布 | 推草稿箱（个人号可用） | `publish_draft.py --dry-run` |
| ⑦ 复盘 | 记日志，每 5 篇回写四库 | — |

单篇生产只是飞轮的一段弧。底下四个库在下持续沉淀，单篇流程在上取用并回写：

| 库 | 文件 | 变化速度 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入收件箱 | `assets/inbox.md` | 快变（日） |
| 范文锚 | `assets/voice-samples/` | 慢变（月） |
| 风格档案 | `assets/voice.md` | 慢变（季度） |
| 教训库 | `assets/lessons.md` | 事件驱动 |

`state.md` 是跨会话状态机——多 Agent 之间切换时，靠它接续上下文，不重复提问。

`references/` 里 38 份方法论按阶段路由见 [`references/INDEX.md`](references/INDEX.md)。

```
gzhflow/
├── AGENTS.md            # 跨 Agent 入口（单一真源）
├── CLAUDE.md            # Claude Code 桥接（@AGENTS.md）
├── state.md             # 跨会话状态机（每次会话先读）

本项目是对作者此前 **Hermes 专属个人公众号工作流**（[Andiii208/andiii-wechat-workflow](https://github.com/Andiii208/andiii-wechat-workflow)）的抽象与泛化：保留其精华方法论（文风路由、去 AI 味手册、配图四件套引擎、设计推理层、质检门），剥离 Hermes 绑定与个人化内容，重构为适配主流 Agent 的范式框架。迁移详情见 [`docs/migration-guide.md`](docs/migration-guide.md)。
MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）；上游许可边界见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

readme.section: gzhflow · A Cross-Agent WeChat Official Account Publishing Workflow
readme.text:
[](LICENSE)

A **reusable, cross-agent** workflow framework for publishing WeChat Official Account (公众号) content: from "a topic" to "a styled, illustrated, de-AI-flavored article in your draft box", as a six-stage pipeline with a quality gate at every step.

> Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, DeepSeek, and other mainstream agents. Also compatible with the Hermes `SKILL.md` format (same-origin standard).

- **Cross-agent, out of the box**: `AGENTS.md` as the single source of truth + a one-line `CLAUDE.md` bridge
- **Six-stage pipeline**: material-first → writing → de-AI → illustration → layout → publish, each with a quality gate
- **Personalization is pluggable**: writing styles / image styles / layout themes live in `config/` + `examples/`, never hard-coded into the flow
- **Three-tier quality gates**: deterministic script gates + LLM self-check checklists + human review/dry-run
- **Works for personal accounts**: official API `draft/add` (available to personal 订阅号) + manual paste fallback
- **Pure CLI tools**: stdlib-first, no external dependencies, cross-platform

```bash
cp config/workflow.example.yaml config/workflow.yaml
cp config/styles.example.yaml config/styles.yaml
cp config/themes.example.yaml config/themes.yaml
cp config/publish.example.yaml config/publish.yaml

python scripts/validate_repo.py

readme.section: "Use the gzhflow workflow to write a WeChat OA article about <topic>"
readme.text:
```

See [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md) for full instructions.

> **Note**: WeChat OA publishing requires a Chinese WeChat Official Account and its AppID/AppSecret. Since 2025-07, personal accounts can no longer use the `freepublish` API to publish directly — `gzhflow` pushes to the **draft box** via `draft/add` (still available), and you tap "publish" in the 公众号助手 app yourself.

gzhflow is also packaged as a DSH plugin (a `dsh.bundle` manifest in `package.json`):

```bash

readme.section: registers 7 gzhflow_* tools (6 quality gates + env self-check) and ships the gzhflow skill
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Andiii208/gzhflow
```

Then tell any session "Use the gzhflow workflow to write a WeChat OA article about <topic>", or load the `gzhflow` skill.

For the "公众号主编" persona (session-scoped, opt-in), install the agent preset:bash
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File dsh-preset/install.ps1   # Windows
bash dsh-preset/install.sh                                       # macOS / Linux
```

See [`dsh-preset/README.md`](dsh-preset/README.md).

| Stage | Purpose | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| ① Material-first | Ask questions to mine real material — never fabricate | Intent triple-check |
| ② Writing | Write in the routed style | `ai_flavor_score.py` + self-check |
| ③ De-AI | Structural surgery + voice + person adaptation | `ai_flavor_score.py` re-check |
| ④ Illustration (opt.) | Source triage → style routing → 4-part prompt | `check_image_prompt.py` |
| ⑤ Layout | Theme routing → Markdown → WeChat HTML | `validate_gzh_html.py` |
| ⑥ Publish | Push to draft box | `publish_draft.py --dry-run` |
MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)); upstream boundaries in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).
